I am old now, and this maize plot is small, so I will manage it in a simple way that I can afford. Because we are in Iringa and maize does well when the rains come, I will still put a little chemical fertilizer and use some manure if I can get it. I will not irrigate, and I will not use pesticide because that costs money and I usually depend on hand weeding and family work, with a little hired help for heavy work.
